My dear [Christabel](/person/329)
I think you should poke up [Strahan](/person/1278), though I fancy he is very tiresome about MSS. [^2] I hope you have a copy – [Goosedom](/topic/104) is very poor this time, all the best being busy or going travelling [Frog](/person/822) is gone to Ammergau[^3]
your affectionate
Mother Goose


[^1]: Endorsed \'Envelope shows 1871\'.
[^2]: Probably this refers to some attempt by Coleridge to publish fiction in [Good Words](/periodical/73), the magazine published by Alexander Strahan.
[^3]: The decennial performance of the Passion Play in the Bavarian village of Oberammergau had become a popular tourist attraction.

The 1870 performance was interrupted by the outbreak of the Franco-Prussian War, and was resumed in June 1871 (Pall Mall Gazette 9 June 1871).
